references.label: 20661 block 0
references.quote: (Published in the Topeka Metro News June 8, 2026)

references.label: 20661 block 1
references.quote: ORDINANCE NO. 20661

references.label: 20661 block 2
references.quote: 5 AN ORDINANCE introduced by City Manager, Dr. Robert M. Perez, concerning class

references.label: 20661 block 3
references.quote: 6 B licenses, amending and repealing Sections 14.15.010 through

references.label: 20661 block 4
references.quote: 7 14.15.080. of the Topeka Municipal Code.

references.label: 20661 block 6
references.quote: 9 BE IT ORDAINED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY OF TOPEKA, KANSAS:

references.label: 20661 block 7
references.quote: 10 Section 1. That Chapter 14.15 Technical Activities of Industries, sections

references.label: 20661 block 9
references.quote: 14.15.080 are hereby amended and repealed.

references.label: 20661 block 10
references.quote: 14.15.010 Definitions.

references.label: 20661 block 11
references.quote: The following words, terms and phrases, when used in this chapter, shall have the

references.label: 20661 block 12
references.quote: meanings ascribed to them in this section, except where the context clearly indicates a

references.label: 20661 block 13
references.quote: different meaning:

references.label: 20661 block 14
references.quote: “Industry” means and includes any corporation, firm or partnership which carries

references.label: 20661 block 15
references.quote: on a business within the City limits which is:

references.label: 20661 block 16
references.quote: (a) A public utility operating under a franchise granted by the City;

references.label: 20661 block 17
references.quote: (b) A railroad operating under the control of the Interstate Commerce

references.label: 20661 block 18
references.quote: Commission; or

references.label: 20661 block 19
references.quote: (c) A business whose business activity is specifically permitted by the use

references.label: 20661 block 20
references.quote: regulations of I-1 light industrial or I-2 heavy industrial district.

references.label: 20661 block 21
references.quote: “New construction” means the erection of any new building or other facility, either

references.label: 20661 block 22
references.quote: detached from existing buildings or facilities or attached but constituting a substantial

references.label: 20661 block 23
references.quote: enlargement of ground surface area or cubical content of an existing building or facility.

references.label: 20661 block 24
references.quote: “Qualified industry” means any industry which has applied for and received a class

references.label: 20661 block 25
references.quote: B license pursuant to the provisions of this chapter.

references.label: 20661 block 26
references.quote: “Technical activities” means the doing of any work by the industry itself or the use

references.label: 20661 block 27
references.quote: or installation of any materials, parts or equipment which is subject to regulation by the

references.label: 20661 block 28
references.quote: City under one or more of the technical codes.

references.label: 20661 block 29
references.quote: “Technical codes” means the building code, plumbing code, electrical code,

references.label: 20661 block 30
references.quote: mechanical code and solar energy code which are adopted by the City.

references.label: 20661 block 32
references.quote: It is hereby declared to be the public policy of this City to provide the best possible

references.label: 20661 block 33
references.quote: environment for the operation of industry consistent with the City’s responsibility to protect

references.label: 20661 block 34
references.quote: the health, safety and welfare of the citizens. It is recognized that various industries have

references.label: 20661 block 35
references.quote: staff who are qualified to carry out technical activities in conformity with the technical

references.label: 20661 block 36
references.quote: codes of the City. It is considered necessary to allow qualified industries to regulate

references.label: 20661 block 37
references.quote: themselves so as to protect the public health and safety and perform their own technical

references.label: 20661 block 38
references.quote: activities.

references.label: 20661 block 39
references.quote: 14.15.030 Scope of chapter.

references.label: 20661 block 40
references.quote: The provisions of this chapter shall be read in conjunction with the applicable

references.label: 20661 block 41
references.quote: technical codes, and nothing contained in this chapter shall be construed to require

references.label: 20661 block 42
references.quote: greater regulation than is set forth in the applicable technical codes.

references.label: 20661 block 43
references.quote: 46 14.15.040 Required.

references.label: 20661 block 44
references.quote: A qualified industry shall comply with the provisions of this chapter as it relates to

references.label: 20661 block 45
references.quote: the technical activities of the industry and shall be subject to regulation by the City only

references.label: 20661 block 46
references.quote: to the extent of the provisions of this chapter; provided, that the industry is the holder of

references.label: 20661 block 47
references.quote: a valid class B license. Notice shall be given to the Development Services Division of any

references.label: 20661 block 48
references.quote: replacement of existing systems which would normally require a permit under the

references.label: 20661 block 49
references.quote: applicable technical code. In no event is a qualified industry authorized by a class B

references.label: 20661 block 50
references.quote: license to undertake new construction.

references.label: 20661 block 51
references.quote: 14.15.050 Conditions for qualifications.

references.label: 20661 block 52
references.quote: An industry shall be considered qualified for a class B license only when and so

references.label: 20661 block 53
references.quote: long as the following conditions are met to the reasonable satisfaction of the Code

references.label: 20661 block 54
references.quote: Enforcement Director:

references.label: 20661 block 55
references.quote: (a) The industry’s technical activities shall be covered by valid public liability

references.label: 20661 block 56
references.quote: insurance written by a company authorized to do business in the State, or the industry

references.label: 20661 block 57
references.quote: may be self-insured with limits of not less than $300,000 for injury or death of any person,

references.label: 20661 block 58
references.quote: not less than $100,000 for property damage in any one occurrence, and not less than

references.label: 20661 block 59
references.quote: $300,000 in aggregate limits for any one occurrence;

references.label: 20661 block 60
references.quote: (b) The industry shall conduct its technical activities under the direct supervision

references.label: 20661 block 61
references.quote: of a resident licensed professional engineer trained in electrical, mechanical and

references.label: 20661 block 62
references.quote: plumbing areas who is a full-time employee or partner or owner of the industry, or cause

references.label: 20661 block 63
references.quote: its technical activities to be checked by an independent resident licensed professional

references.label: 20661 block 64
references.quote: engineer trained in electrical, mechanical and plumbing areas who shall be responsible

references.label: 20661 block 65
references.quote: for certifying that the technical activities are being conducted in accordance with the

references.label: 20661 block 66
references.quote: applicable technical code or codes; or

references.label: 20661 block 67
references.quote: (c) The industry shall cause its technical activities to be controlled and supervised

references.label: 20661 block 68
references.quote: but not necessarily performed by a full-time employee, or partner or owner, who shall

references.label: 20661 block 69
references.quote: satisfy the Code Enforcement Director that he is capable by training and experience of

references.label: 20661 block 70
references.quote: applying the technical codes to the extent such codes are applicable to the operations of

references.label: 20661 block 71
references.quote: the particular industry. There shall be on file with the Code Enforcement Director the

references.label: 20661 block 72
references.quote: name, residence and address of such person and a statement signed by such person

references.label: 20661 block 73
references.quote: setting forth in detail the person’s qualifications and experience for such duties. If an

references.label: 20661 block 74
references.quote: industry uses separate individuals for the supervision of its technical activities, separate

references.label: 20661 block 75
references.quote: statements shall be filed by each individual;

references.label: 20661 block 76
references.quote: (d) The industry shall be a holder of a current class B license.

references.label: 20661 block 77
references.quote: 14.15.060 Application for class B license.

references.label: 20661 block 78
references.quote: (a) Application for a class B license shall be made on a form provided by the

references.label: 20661 block 79
references.quote: Development Services Division and shall set forth:

references.label: 20661 block 80
references.quote: (1) The industry’s agreement that its technical activities will conform to the

references.label: 20661 block 81
references.quote: applicable technical codes and further that it will correct any work found not to be in

references.label: 20661 block 82
references.quote: conformity.

references.label: 20661 block 83
references.quote: (2) A certificate of insurance showing the industry’s compliance with the

references.label: 20661 block 84
references.quote: requirement of public liability insurance or evidence of self-insurance.

references.label: 20661 block 85
references.quote: (3) Written documentation of the industry’s compliance with TMC 14.15.050(b) or

references.label: 20661 block 87
references.quote: 90 (b) The application fee for a class B license shall be as specified in TMC

references.label: 20661 block 90
references.quote: Class B licenses shall be renewed on a yearly basis. Each industry wishing to

references.label: 20661 block 91
references.quote: renew its class B license shall file with the Division of Building Inspection:

references.label: 20661 block 92
references.quote: (a) Current certificate of insurance or evidence of self-insurance.

references.label: 20661 block 93
references.quote: (b) The industry’s agreement that its technical activities shall conform to the

references.label: 20661 block 94
references.quote: applicable technical codes.

references.label: 20661 block 95
references.quote: (c) Written documentation of the industry’s compliance with TMC 14.15.050(b) or

references.label: 20661 block 97
references.quote: (d) Renewal fee as specified in TMC 5.10.110.

references.label: 20661 block 98
references.quote: 14.15.080 Inspections – Revocation of license for failure to comply.

references.label: 20661 block 99
references.quote: (a) The code enforcement officer and Fire Chief or their designees retain the right

references.label: 20661 block 100
references.quote: of access at reasonable times to enter the premises of a class B license holder for the

references.label: 20661 block 101
references.quote: purpose of making inspections to assure compliance with the appropriate technical code.

references.label: 20661 block 102
references.quote: (b) Whenever the code enforcement officer shall find upon inspection that an

references.label: 20661 block 103
references.quote: industry’s technical activities are not being conducted in conformity with acceptable

references.label: 20661 block 104
references.quote: standards or that work has been performed in such a manner as to constitute a potential

references.label: 20661 block 105
references.quote: danger to life or property, then, upon 15 days’ written notice to the holder of the class B

references.label: 20661 block 106
references.quote: license, the code enforcement officer shall revoke such class B license unless within such

references.label: 20661 block 107
references.quote: 15 days the industry shall bring its activities into conformance with the applicable technical

references.label: 20661 block 108
references.quote: codes or indicate its intent to bring its activities into conformance within a stated time

references.label: 20661 block 109
references.quote: frame.

references.label: 20661 block 110
references.quote: (c) Notwithstanding the provisions of this chapter, failure by a licensed industry to

references.label: 20661 block 111
references.quote: comply with applicable technical codes or failure to take corrective action as required by

references.label: 20661 block 112
references.quote: the code enforcement officer shall result in a complaint being filed in Municipal Court.

references.label: 20661 block 113
references.quote: (d) Any industry aggrieved by an order, ruling or decision of the code enforcement

references.label: 20661 block 114
references.quote: officer pursuant to this chapter may appeal such decision to the appropriate board of

references.label: 20661 block 115
references.quote: appeals, as set forth in the respective technical code.

references.label: 20661 block 116
references.quote: Section 2. This ordinance shall take effect and be in force from and after its

references.label: 20661 block 117
references.quote: passage, approval and publication in the official City newspaper.

references.label: 20661 block 118
references.quote: Section 3. This ordinance shall supersede all ordinances, resolutions or rules,

references.label: 20661 block 119
references.quote: or portions thereof, which are in conflict with the provisions of this ordinance.

references.label: 20661 block 120
references.quote: Section 4. Should any section, clause or phrase of this ordinance be declared

references.label: 20661 block 121
references.quote: invalid by a court of competent jurisdiction, the same shall not affect the validity of this

references.label: 20661 block 122
references.quote: ordinance as a whole, or any part thereof, other than the part so declared to be invalid.

references.label: 20661 block 123
references.quote: PASSED AND APPROVED by the City Council on June 2, 2026.

references.label: 20661 block 124
